SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.    File No.
Section 1, Special Branch,
REPORT
Date... October 29, 1937.
Subject... Shanghai Municipality Student Circles' National Salvation
Association - inaugurated.
Made by ...I. Shih Ssu-chien... Forwarded by ... /

The Shanghai Municipality Student Circles' National
Salvation Association (上海市学生界救亡协会), which came into
existence at the beginning of September and was later disbanded
owing to internal dissension, was re-organized and inaugurated
in a meeting held between 3 p.m. and 5 p.m. on October 28, 1937,
on the 6th floor of the Footung Countrymen's Association, 1454
Avenue Edward VII. Some 45 persons representing the following
schools and organizations were present:-
1. China University, 826 Ferry Road;
2. University of Shanghai, 209 Yuen Ming Yuen Road;
3. Shanghai Law College, 167 Tatung Road;
4. Doong Tuh Medical School, 1/67 Yates Road;
5. Chi Chi University, 1510 Avenue Road;
6. Medhurst College, 316 Yu Ya Ching Road;
7. Kwang Hwa University, 24/1032 Yu Yuen Road;
8. Dah Kung Middle School, Avenue Joffre;
9. Peiping and Tientsin Students' Association,
1335 Bubbling Well Road;
10. Shanghai Municipality Military Trained Students'
National Salvation Association, 40 Moulmein Road;
11. The National Salvation Association of Students
Returned from Japan, 256 Avenue Dubail.
Newspapers entitled "War Time Students" (战时学生)
purporting to have been published by the above Association were
distributed to the participating members. The newspaper
contains articles calling upon the people to present a united
front in support of the Government.
During the course of the meeting, the following
resolutions were passed:-

日期……1937年10月29日。
主题……上海市学生界救亡协会——成立。
制作人……施思坚（I. Shih Ssu-chien）……转发人…… /

上海市学生界救亡协会于九月初成立，后因内部纷争而解散，该会经改组后，于1937年10月28日下午3时至5时，在爱多亚路（Avenue Edward VII）1454号浦东同乡会六楼举行的会议上重新成立并举行 inauguration 仪式。约有45名代表下列学校和组织的人员出席：-
1. 中国大学，斐伦路（Ferry Road）826号；
2. 沪江大学，圆明园路209号；
3. 上海法科大学，大通路（Tatung Road）167号；
4. 同德医学院，耶茨路（Yates Road）1/67号；
5. 暨南大学，爱文义路（Avenue Road）1510号；
6. 麦伦中学，虞洽卿路（Yu Ya Ching Road）316号；
7. 光华大学，愚园路（Yu Yuen Road）24/1032号；
8. 大公中学，霞飞路（Avenue Joffre）；
9. 平津同学会，静安寺路（Bubbling Well Road）1335号；
10. 上海市军训学生救亡协会，莫尔缅路（Moulmein Road）40号；
11. 留日学生救亡协会，杜美路（Avenue Dubail）256号。
声称由上述协会出版的名为《战时学生》的报纸已分发给与会成员。该报刊登文章，呼吁民众呈现统一战线以支持政府。
会议期间，通过了以下决议：-

1). That a telegram be dispatched to General Chiang Kai-shek and the Commanders at the front expressing the high esteem they are held in by the members of the Association.
2). That a manifesto supporting the National Government in its resistance against Japanese aggression be dispatched.
3). That a telegram be dispatched to the forthcoming Nine Power Conference requesting them to uphold justice and to apply sanctions against Japan.
4). That a circular telegram be dispatched to all Universities and High Schools throughout the country urging them to support the National Government.
5). That a telegram be dispatched to Student Associations in foreign countries urging them to render assistance to China.
It is learned that Messrs. Ong Yue Woo (温裕和), a member of the Shanghai Various Circles' Committee to Support Resistance against the Enemy, and Tong Chih Tsung (汤执中), both of whom are students of the Chinan University, are the chief promoters of the above mentioned Association, but so far no office has been opened. Names of the executive members of the Association are being obtained.
With reference to the remarks of the D.C. (Special Branch) on the attached Intelligence Report of Oct. 29, 1937, the Association has made no attempt to register with the Shanghai Municipal Council, but efforts are being made by detectives attached to Special Branch to locate the responsible members of the Association and, when successful, they will be warned to comply with the Council's instructions.

Ta Kung Pao and other local newspapers :- 10-11-37 (A.M.)
THE STUDENTS' NATIONAL SALVATION ASSOCIATION
The Chinese Students' National Salvation Association
is undertaking the registration of homeless students.
On November 8 the Association started its propaganda
work for the protection of Greater Shanghai. To-day it
will hold an extensive lecturing party and will commence
a campaign to solicit contributions.

《大公报》及其他本地报纸：- 1937年11月10日（上午）
学生救亡协会
中国学生救亡协会正在进行无家可归学生的登记工作。
11月8日，该会开始了保护大上海的宣传工作。今日将举行大型演讲团活动，并开始发起募捐运动。

Chiu Huang Jih Pao (救亡日報), a mosquito paper :- 10-37(〃)
STUDENTS AND THE SETTLEMENT AUTHORITIES
The Shanghai Students' National Salvation
Association held a meeting on November 8 to discuss its
propaganda campaign in connection with the protection of
Greater Shanghai.
It was resolved that the Government be
petitioned to ask the Settlement authorities not to
oppress persons engaged in national salvation work.

上海学生救亡协会于11月8日举行会议，讨论有关保护大上海的宣传运动。

October 29, 1937.
Afternoon Translation.

To Kung Pao and other local newspapers :-

INAUGURATION OF STUDENTS' NATIONAL SALVATION ASSOCIATION

The local Students' National Salvation
Association was inaugurated at a meeting held at 2 p.m.
yesterday. Some 100 persons representing 36 schools,
the Tangpu and other political organizations and various
national salvation associations were present.
After the deputies of the Bureau of Social
Affairs, the Cultural Circles' National Salvation Association
and the Chinese Y.W.C.A. had delivered speeches of
encouragement to the students, the following resolutions
were discussed and passed :-
1) That a telegram of comfort be dispatched to General
Chiang Kai-shek and the officers and men at the front;
that a circular telegram be issued supporting the
Government's resistance to the end; that the Government
be requested to sever all connection with Japan.
2) That a telegram be dispatched to Dr. Wellington Koo,
the Chinese representative to the Nine-Power Conference,
requesting him to struggle for right and to reject
mediation; that a telegram be dispatched to the delegates
of various foreign countries to the Nine-Power Conference
through the Chairman of the Conference requesting them
to apply sanctions against Japan and explaining the
determination of China to resist the enemy and her
firm decision to reject all offers of mediation.
3) That a circular be issued to all students in the world.
4) That students throughout the country be urged to
mobilize and to undertake practical work for the
salvation of the nation.
5) That the Ministry of Education be requested to device
plans for war-time education.
6) That a telegram be dispatched to General Li Tsung-jen
supporting his views on the students' movements and
urging him to carry out his views.
7) That the Central People's Training Department be
requested to train students and youths who are jobless.
8) That a Committee to be known as "The Special Committee
to Work for the Protection of Greater Shanghai" be
formed with an office in the rear of the war zone;
that a movement for the formation of a Students'
Volunteer Army to Protect Greater Shanghai be initiated.
9) That members of the Association be mobilized to persuade
the public to buy Liberty Bonds.
10) That propaganda work in various foreign countries be
conducted by radio; that broadcasts be sent to Chinese
in the North-East.
11) That practical support be given to the mobile units of
students in Peiping.

I.R. and Special Report,
29/10/37.

1937年10月29日。
下午译文。

致《大公报》及其他本地报纸：-

学生救亡协会成立

本地学生救亡协会于昨日下午2时举行的会议上成立。约有100名代表36所学校、塘浦及其他政治组织和各救亡协会的人员出席。
在社会局、文化界救亡协会和中国基督教女青年会的代表向学生发表鼓励讲话后，讨论并通过了以下决议：-
1) 向蒋介石将军及前线官兵发送慰问电报；发布通函电报支持政府抗战到底；请求政府断绝与日本的一切联系。
2) 向九国公约会议中国代表顾维钧博士发送电报，请求其争取正义并拒绝调停；通过会议主席向参加九国公约会议的各国代表发送电报，请求他们对日本实施制裁，并说明中国抗敌的决心以及拒绝一切调停提议的坚定决定。
3) 向全世界所有学生发布通函。
4) 敦促全国学生动员起来，从事救国的实际工作。
5) 请求教育部制定战时教育计划。
6) 向李宗仁将军发送电报，支持他对学生运动的观点，并敦促他贯彻其观点。
7) 请求中央民众训练部培训失业学生和青年。
8) 成立一个名为“保护大上海特别工作委员会”的委员会，办公地点设在战区后方；发起组建“保护大上海学生志愿军”的运动。
9) 动员协会会员劝说公众购买公债。
10) 通过无线电在各外国开展宣传工作；向东北地区的中国人发送广播。
11) 给予北平学生流动队实际支持。

I.R. 及特别报告，
1937年10月29日。
